title: Remove Diagnostics init flat export
summary: Moved Diagnostics startup wiring to the mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView namespace and removed the transitional initDiagnosticsViewEvents flat window export.
reason: Continue reducing WebView flat compatibility exports by touched Diagnostics domain while preserving script-order startup behavior and backend-owned mutation boundaries.
behavior_before: app.js initialized Diagnostics with the flat initDiagnosticsViewEvents() global, and diagnosticsView.js assigned window.initDiagnosticsViewEvents in addition to the mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView namespace member.
behavior_after: app.js initializes Diagnostics through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView?.initDiagnosticsViewEvents?.(), diagnosticsView.js keeps only the namespace member, and static coverage rejects reintroducing the flat assignment or direct startup call.
tests_added: Updated LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert app.js uses mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView.initDiagnosticsViewEvents and diagnosticsView.js does not assign window.initDiagnosticsViewEvents.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_diagnostics_handoff_smoke -q (passes with the existing malformed broken-active-job.json warning)
rollback_plan: Restore the app.js direct initDiagnosticsViewEvents() call, restore the window.initDiagnosticsViewEvents assignment in diagnosticsView.js, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the flat-export counts/inventory entry.
notes:
Moved Diagnostics initialization from the flat global to the mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView namespace.
Removed the legacy initDiagnosticsViewEvents flat export while retaining the namespace member.
Added static coverage for namespace startup and absence of the Diagnostics init flat assignment.
Updated the tracked WebView flat-export count after the Diagnostics init cleanup.
Updated the Diagnostics flat-export inventory and total.
Regenerated the WebView public contract baseline after removing the flat initializer export.
Refreshed generated summary for current-state documentation.
